reviews.text:
My dog is transformed! I enrolled my guy Bloopy into DareDevil's board & train (12 day Jump Start) program to finally take care of some sidewalk snacking, play biting, and on-leash stubbornness that had been getting worse and worse. We worked with trainer Jess who gave us incredible tips and strategies during our initial pre-boarding training session. He was already taking to it so nicely by the time he got boarded at Jess's place that the rest was a breeze.

By the time he got home he was 500% better and our walks have been totally transformed. He seems happier now that he knows what he's supposed to do and I can tell he had a blast in Jess' care. I know it takes a lot of constant reinforcement from us, his owners, in the weeks following. But the foundation he got from the DareDevil Jump Start program is making that so easy.

If you live in Philadelphia in an urban environment, I highly recommend this program over other Board & Trains elsewhere. The fact that the trainers live in the city mimics the dog's daily life so they'll encounter more of the everyday distractions and environments they usually do. Couldn't recommend this program more!

Alyssa was so helpful with our little rescue, Ellie. She’s a middle aged dog who came from who knows where after who knows what experiences. Her most challenging behavioral issue was her reactivity towards other dogs on walks. We see many other dogs on every walk, so after a year of trying everything, it was getting exhausting. Alyssa worked with us privately for three sessions and we learned so much from her! Ellie showed improvement right away and has continued to improve. She can’t easily pass a dog right next to us on the sidewalk yet, but she can see a dog across the street or near us in the park without reacting. Sometimes she looks at the other dog, looks at me and licks her lips, knowing she earns a reward for staying attentive to me and not the dog. Thank you, Alyssa 😊

Updating almost a year later just to say we’ve continued to have the same wonderful experience I mentioned the first time around ❤️

__
Can’t say enough good things about this group. Training expertise and level of overall service they provide is top notch. The pup is lucky to have them, especially Jess - it’s amazing to have someone as skilled and trustworthy as she is to take care of his training and boarding (graduates only!) needs. He’ll be going to them for life.

Jess and the rest of the Daredevil team did wonderful with Ghost during his board and train. We got daily updates on social media and frequent detailed email updates as well. He also got a mini spa before he came home. All interaction with other dogs was in a monitored and controlled environment, and he has been much more independent and confident at home since the program. Greyhounds are known to be sensitive and have their quirks but the experience is so tailored towards each individual dog that we didn't have to worry at all.

I’m leaving this review to encourage anyone who’s considering Alyssa and Dare Devil for their pup… DO IT!!!! We have a 1.5 year old small/medium dog who needed help with leash walking and decompression in the house. Our dog did the 12 day board and train program with Alyssa and it is the best money we have ever spent. He walks fabulously now and we’ve walked longer and farther than we were ever able to before - I never thought I’d say this but we really ENJOY walking him now. He also now makes great choices in the house independently, choosing a chew toy himself rather than nipping at our house guests to get them to play (like he used to).  He also learned a place command and is doing great with it! AND when Alyssa came for our follow up session 1 week later - I’ve never seen him so excited to see someone! So I KNOW she must have treated him excellently and he really enjoyed his time with her.

I read the great reviews beforehand and still wasn’t convinced that our stubborn pup would be as receptive as other dogs, but I truly can’t recommend this training program enough. Alyssa made a dog we were already in love with even more lovable and I can’t thank her enough!
Love working with Jess and team, truly the best. Extremely thorough, update you while away, and do a great job with follow ups. Our pup is always excited to go back!

Jess had my dog, Chase, for their 12 day Jump Start Board & Train program. I could not be happier with the results. Jess laid an excellent foundation for Chase to help him settle on his own at home, stay focused on walks, etc. While Chase isn't reactive, he's a social butterfly which can make walks challenging with the variety of distractions living in the city. Chase came home with much more structure and is overall calmer, more focused, and his engagement with me is better than ever. Huge bonus that they will board their graduates at their home and do training brush-ups. Knowing he is at a place he enjoys, brushing up his training, and getting all the engagement he needs to be happy & fulfilled is a huge relief when I'm away. If you're thinking about it - do it!!

We couldn’t be more grateful for Jess, Jamie, and Alyssa. I was nervous about letting our little buddy in someone else’s care for 3 weeks, but I had nothing to worry about. They took such good care of our anxious little pup and helped him learn coping mechanisms for when he meets new people and encounters other stressful situations. The lessons are practical, and our main trainer, Jess, helped us tailor the lessons / schedule / tips to our lives. Highly communicative, easy to work with, and I would recommend them 10 times over to anyone.

My dog had a wonderful experience with the 3 week training.  Also, we board him with them when we have to leave town and he loves the trainers while getting a touch up on his skills with refreshers.

To say the least, we trust them with our dog's life.

We are so pleased with the training of our two dogs. We have a mature, older, large German Shepherd/Poodle and a Miniature Schnauzer puppy with different needs. Both dogs boarded with DareDevil, and we also had in-home training. We have found the programs thorough and easy to implement.

Amazing team at Daredevildogtraining!  We received the best customer experience and the training has been life changing for the humans and the canines!  Jess was great.  We received updates from her along the way.  The positive changes in our dog’s behavior has been remarkable.  Only great things to say about our experience.

I cannot recommend DareDevil Training enough! We have a 1-year-old teacup Goldendoodle who was having resource guarding and handling sensitivity problems. We sent her to the 3-week behavioral program with Jess and are extremely pleased with the results so far. Jess was communicative during the entire process and really focused on the areas our dog needed. She has been home for the last few days, and we are already seeing the results. Jess was very good at communicating our at-home training program, which is structured in a way that makes it easy to follow with our lifestyle and maintain. We are excited to continue with our follow-up lessons and see the results continue to develop. It is also great because they will board your dog when you go away after you complete your program. This is a fantastic offering if you are dealing with a dog that may have aggression issues, making it difficult to send them to a regular kennel. We looked at about 10 board-and-train programs before choosing DareDevil, and they were by far the best option. If you have behavioral problems with your dog, I would recommend them 10/10. It is money very well spent!

If you just got a puppy, this is the place to take them to! I did so much research on the best-rated schools in town and so glad I decided to go with DareDevil for Khloe’s puppy program. If you live in Philly and want a well-socialized city dog, look no further.

I was stressed and facing puppy blues when I got my 11 week old dog as she had zoomies constantly, tested our boundaries, kept trying to chew things up, barked all the time and at everything, and was scared about her crate door closing. I literally couldn’t sleep till midnight, leave her home alone, take her anywhere in an uber or sit outside without her overstimulated/barking. Alyssa did a free intro zoom call to discuss my training goals and also provide training skills to start with Khloe without pressuring me to bring my puppy in for any paid programs. I was also able to learn my own training mistakes (such as allowing on-leash greetings/petting that was aggravating Khloe’s bad behavior). I decided to do the board & train 6 day program and was so impressed by how Khloe came back.

After just 6 days she was crate, potty, and playpen trained and was much better able to settle down with a HUGE reduction in barking + a whole lot of commands/skills learned. There was also 2 follow up in-home lessons that really helped especially to reinforce what she learned and to deal with any training regression along the way.

Obviously there has been (mostly) ups and downs in behavior but honestly really manageable for me to correct them since Khloe went for her program. Not only is my puppy happier but I am too — I really felt a huge weight lifted off my shoulders as I now have a good routine with her, and time for myself knowing she can settle down on her own. Huge kudos to Alyssa & Team, for their work ethic, dedication, and setting Khloe up for success (and giving my peace of mind back) !

Jenn was wonderful.  She really taught  Taylor puppy manners.  I was surprised to see the progress they made.
